description: Compute the WCAG 2.1 contrast ratio between two fully opaque CSS color strings and return WCAG tier flags (AA/AAA normal/large text). Set apca:true to also get the signed APCA-W3 Lc for text `a` over background `b`.

a.description: First CSS color string, e.g. "#000000", "black", "oklch(0 0 0)" (max 256 chars)

apca.description: When true, additionally compute the APCA-W3 (SAPC-4g) lightness contrast Lc for text `a` over background `b` (returned as `apcaLc`)

b.description: Second CSS color string, e.g. "#ffffff", "white", "oklch(1 0 0)" (max 256 chars)

name: contrast

aaLarge.description: Meets WCAG 2.1 AA for large text (raw ratio >= 3)

aaNormal.description: Meets WCAG 2.1 AA for normal text (raw ratio >= 4.5)

aaaLarge.description: Meets WCAG 2.1 AAA for large text (raw ratio >= 4.5)

aaaNormal.description: Meets WCAG 2.1 AAA for normal text (raw ratio >= 7)

apcaLc.description: Signed APCA-W3 (SAPC-4g) Lc for text `a` over background `b`, rounded to 2 decimals (positive = dark-on-light, negative = light-on-dark); present only when input `apca` is true

ratio.description: 2-decimal display value; tier flags derive from the unrounded raw ratio
